sentences.en: The formerly homeless person now lives in a first-class residence.
sentences.zh: 1. 这位曾经无家可归的人现在住在一流的住宅里。

sentences.en: He didn't deny that he was formerly involved in the program.
sentences.zh: 2. 他没有否认自己以前曾参与过该计划。

sentences.en: The morals of children are tenfold worse than formerly.
sentences.zh: 3. 孩子们的道德水平比过去糟糕十倍。
